title: Gopal Krishna Tadepalli vs Mohd. Anwar Hussain & another
nature: suit for specific performance of agreement of sale
one_line_summary: Agreement of sale for a 200 sq. yd plot at Nagole; defendants refuse to execute sale deed after receiving Rs. 18 lakh advance.
court: Court of the IV Additional Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad

hearings.outcome: PW1 partly cross-examined by counsel for defendants
hearings.order_sheet: PW1 present. Partly cross-examined by counsel for defendants. For further cross-examination, call on 16.04.2025.
hearings.note: OS 318/22 Tadepalli. PW1 (Gopal garu himself) cross by Achary for about 40 min. Mostly on why balance consideration was not tendered before the agreement date. He held up ok. Achary kept asking about the bank statement - make sure Ex.A7 original is in the file next time.

action_items.task: keep original of Ex.A7 bank statement in court file

hearings.order_sheet: PW1 further cross-examined and discharged. Plaintiff to take steps for PW2. Call on 25.06.2025.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - PW1 cross over, finally. Achary tried the 'readiness and willingness' line again, Gopal garu answered well, said he had the loan sanction letter ready from Jan 2021. Need to summon the attesting witness Narsing Rao as PW2. Sai to prepare summons batta.

action_items.task: take out summons to attesting witness (PW2) with batta

hearings.note: Tadepalli - not reached. PW2 Narsing Rao came and waited till 4.30, poor man. Paid his auto fare. Told him we will call a day before next date.

hearings.outcome: PW2 examined and cross-examined; plaintiff evidence closed
hearings.order_sheet: PW2 examined in chief. Cross-examined by counsel for defendants. Discharged. Plaintiff's evidence closed. For defendants' evidence, call on 10.09.2025.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - PW2 done, judge recorded it the same day even though it went till 5.15. Achary's cross of PW2 was short, only asked if he read the agreement before signing. Plaintiff evidence closed. Now DW1 chief affidavit has to come from their side. Told Gopal garu it will still take some months.
hearings.client_interaction: Told client that defendant evidence is next and it may take 3-4 months.

hearings.order_sheet: Presiding Officer on leave. Adjourned to 12.11.2025.

hearings.outcome: DW1 chief-examination affidavit filed; posted for cross
hearings.order_sheet: Chief-examination affidavit of DW1 (1st defendant) filed. Exs. B1 to B4 marked. For cross-examination of DW1, call on 17.12.2025.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - DW1 affidavit (Anwar Hussain) filed and B1-B4 marked. B3 is a so-called 'cancellation notice' dated 2021 which we never received - need to check the postal cover in our file. Prepare cross. Key point: he admits receipt of 18 lakh in para 6 of his own affidavit.

action_items.task: check whether cancellation notice (Ex.B3) was ever received; look for postal cover
action_items.reference: no postal cover in our file; client confirms never received

hearings.outcome: Time sought by counsel for plaintiff
hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for plaintiff seeks time as she is part-heard in the High Court. Granted. Call on 04.02.2026.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - I could not reach, stuck in HC part-heard (Bedi WP). Sai sought time on our behalf. That is one adjournment on OUR side before this judge, remember he counts.

hearings.outcome: Not reached (court busy with part-heard trial)
hearings.order_sheet: Part-heard trial in O.S. 1043/2021 in progress. This matter not reached. Call on 18.03.2026.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - not reached, judge spent the whole day on the Lakshmi Ganapathi arguments (our own matter, funny). Nothing new.

hearings.outcome: DW1 partly cross-examined by counsel for plaintiff
hearings.order_sheet: DW1 present. Partly cross-examined by counsel for plaintiff. For further cross-examination, call on 29.04.2026.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - cross of DW1 started. Got him to admit he received 18 lakh in 3 instalments and that he never returned it. He said the cancellation notice was sent by 'ordinary post' - no proof. Still to cover: the encumbrance he created in 2023 (mortgage to Andhra Bank). Continue next date.

action_items.task: get certified copy of 2023 mortgage deed from SRO Nagole

hearings.note: Tadepalli - not reached. Board had 60+ items.

hearings.outcome: Adjournment sought by defendants' counsel citing illness; granted
hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for defendants absent. Junior counsel represents that Sri Ch. Venugopal Achary is unwell and files memo seeking time. Granted. Call on 22.07.2026.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - Achary's junior came with a memo, 'counsel unwell, viral fever'. Judge granted without fuss, first one from their side. DW1 was not even present, so they were not going to go ahead anyway. Gopal garu upset, said he has been coming for 4 years.
hearings.client_interaction: Calmed client down, explained first adjournment is usually granted.
hearings.adjournment_reason: counsel Sri Ch. Venugopal Achary unwell (viral fever), memo filed by junior

hearings.order_sheet: DW1 further cross-examined in part by counsel for plaintiff. For further cross-examination, call on 18.08.2026.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - good day. Confronted DW1 with the 2023 mortgage CC. He admitted mortgaging the plot AFTER the suit was filed and during the pendency. That goes to his conduct and also lis pendens. Need one more short session, maybe 30 min, on the valuation point. Then their DW2.

hearings.outcome: Second adjournment sought by defendants' counsel citing illness; last opportunity
hearings.order_sheet: Counsel for defendants absent. Memo filed stating counsel is indisposed. Adjournment granted as a last opportunity. Call on 16.09.2026.
hearings.note: Tadepalli - AGAIN Achary unwell, memo filed at 10.40 by his junior. 2nd time on their side in this case. Judge wrote 'last opportunity' and said orally 'next time I will not be so kind, counsel'. Gopal garu asked me in the corridor whether we can ask for costs - he has taken leave 6 times. Told him yes, if they seek time again we will press for costs and the judge has done it before.

action_items.task: if defendants seek time again, press for costs; keep C12 and C19 cost orders handy

hearings.client_interaction: Client asked whether costs can be claimed for repeated adjournments. Told him we will press for costs if a third adjournment is sought.
hearings.adjournment_reason: counsel Sri Ch. Venugopal Achary indisposed, memo filed by junior

hearings.note: Tadepalli - not reached, long list. Achary's junior was present this time (!). Next date 5 Oct.
